storyTitle: Create Unscheduled Game Matchups with Drag-and-Drop Scheduling

testCases.description: Check that the feature meets this requirement: Verify that the Create Games action is available under the Schedule Automation dropdown on the Schedule Pool screen.
Check that the feature meets this requirement: Verify that clicking Create Games generates game matchups without automatically scheduling them.
Check that the feature meets this requirement: Verify that game matchups are generated for all divisions and pools in a single action.
Check that the feature meets this requirement: Verify that generated game matchups satisfy the configured Guaranteed Games requirement.
Check that the feature meets this requirement: Verify that clicking the action button when no games exist generates the required matchups.

Check that the feature meets this requirement: Verify that clicking the action button after games have been created, without resetting them, opens the existing unscheduled games instead of generating duplicate matchups.
Check that the feature meets this requirement: Verify that the created games have a RESET option.
Check that the feature meets this requirement: Verify that clicking RESET removes all created games that are still unscheduled.
Check that the feature meets this requirement: Verify that clicking RESET removes games placed in the scheduler that are still in Unsaved status.
Check that the feature meets this requirement: Verify that clicking RESET does not remove games already in Draft or Published status from the scheduler.
Check that the feature meets this requirement: Verify that after RESET, the RESET button changes to CREATE, allowing the admin to generate the matchups again.
Check that the feature meets this requirement: Verify that newly created matchups appear in the Unscheduled Games list.
Check that the feature meets this requirement: Verify that the Unscheduled Games panel opens automatically after games are created.
Check that the feature meets this requirement: Verify that the Unscheduled Games panel can be manually opened and closed using the available toggle control.
Check that the feature meets this requirement: Verify that the total number of unscheduled games is displayed correctly in the panel header.
Check that the feature meets this requirement: Verify that each unscheduled game displays both team names and its division/age group.
Check that the feature meets this requirement: Verify that the unscheduled games list can be filtered by division/age group.
Check that the feature meets this requirement: Verify that the unscheduled games list can be filtered by team.
Check that the feature meets this requirement: Verify that the unscheduled games list can be searched by team name.
Check that the feature meets this requirement: Verify that the message "No games yet" is displayed when all created games have been reset and no games remain.
Check that the feature meets this requirement: Verify that the message "All games are scheduled" is displayed when all created games have been scheduled.
Check that the feature meets this requirement: Verify that opening the Unscheduled Games panel on wide screens pushes the scheduler grid aside.
Check that the feature meets this requirement: Verify that an unscheduled game can be dragged into an empty scheduler cell.
Check that the feature meets this requirement: Verify that dropping an unscheduled game onto an occupied scheduler cell follows the existing confirmation flow for REPLACE.
Check that the feature meets this requirement: Verify that confirming the REPLACE action exchanges the positions of the two games.
Check that the feature meets this requirement: Verify that dropping a scheduled game onto an occupied scheduler cell follows the existing confirmation flow for SWAP or REPLACE, as applicable.
Check that the feature meets this requirement: Verify that each scheduled game displays an Unschedule (×) control until games are in UNSAVED status.
Check that the feature meets this requirement: Verify that clicking the Unschedule (×) control removes the game from the scheduler and returns it to the Unscheduled Games list.
Check that the feature meets this requirement: Verify that both affected scheduler cells display a visible conflict warning when the same team is assigned to two games within the same time slot.
Check that the feature meets this requirement: Verify that scheduling conflict warnings do not prevent the admin from placing a game in the scheduler.
Check that the feature meets this requirement: Verify that games placed through drag-and-drop remain in Unsaved status until the schedule is drafted or published.
Check what happens when there are no matching results.
Check search behavior when the search box is empty.
Cancel replacing a game in an occupied scheduler cell.
